news.title: Man killed, suspect charged with murder in Hwy 78 road rage shooting
news.summary: A 54-year-old man is in custody after a deadly shooting on Stone Mountain Freeway (Hwy 78) on Saturday afternoon, according to DeKalb County Police Department.

news.title: Chattahoochee Tech awarded $750,000 Lowe’s Foundation grant for skilled trades
news.summary: Chattahoochee Technical College was awarded a $750,000 grant this past week from the Lowe’s Foundation to expand training for skilled trades careers.

news.title: Coroner's inquest ordered in Paulding death of Heather Turner

news.title: 1 found dead in Gwinnett parking lot after officers hear gunshots
news.summary: Gwinnett County police detectives are investigating a fatal shooting that occurred early Sunday in a parking lot along Stone Mountain Highway in Snellville.

news.title: Man killed in Gwinnett County shooting, suspect in custody
news.summary: The Gwinnett County Police Department are investigating a deadly shooting off Stone Mountain Highway.

news.title: Man killed in road-rage shooting near Stone Mountain Park
news.summary: DeKalb Police confirmed Saturday that a man died in a shooting on Highway 78 near Stone Mountain Park, and one person is in custody.

news.title: Man dead after overnight shooting in Snellville; suspect in custody
news.summary: A man is dead after an overnight shooting in Snellville. Gwinnett County Police arrested a male suspect fleeing the scene. The investigation is ongoing.

news.title: All clear at Arbor Place Mall after bomb threat prompts evacuation
news.summary: Douglasville Police Department have given the all clear after a bomb threat at Arbor Place Mall prompted an evacuation on Saturday evening.

news.title: Arrest made in connection with deadly Piedmont Park 404 Day shooting
news.summary: A 17-year-old turned himself in connection with the deadly shooting at Piedmont Park on 404 Day, according to the Atlanta Police Department.

news.title: Gwinnett County mom presses for answers after son assaulted, robbed at gas station
news.summary: A Gwinnett County mother is pleading for help from the community to identify potential suspects after her 21-year-old son was assaulted and robbed outside of a gas station near Duluth.

news.title: Family seeks justice for 26-year-old killed in I-285 road rage shooting
news.summary: The family of a 26-year-old man shot and killed in a brazen road rage incident on Interstate 285 is pleading for the public's help to find the gunman responsible.

news.title: 1 person dead, 1 in custody after road rage shooting near Stone Mountain Park
news.summary: According to Gwinnett County police, although the shooting occurred near the county line, the incident began in DeKalb County.

news.title: Henry County Police search for man accused of vandalizing Flock cameras
news.summary: The Henry County Police Department is looking for a man accused of vandalizing two Flock cameras.

news.title: Arbor Place Mall evacuated due to bomb threat, police say
news.summary: In a Facebook post, Douglasville Police said the mall was evacuated around 6 p.m.
